orgDesign.companyProfile: Global ride-sharing marketplace business combining rider demand, driver and fleet supply, business travel programs, safety operations, and shared marketplace-control platforms.
orgDesign.operatingModel: Customer-facing teams own rider, driver, fleet, and business outcomes while shared marketplace teams own dispatch, pricing, trust, and analytics reused across every product surface.
designPrinciples: Keep rider, driver, and business loops explicit because their economics and workflow tradeoffs differ materially.
Treat dispatch, pricing, and trust as core control functions rather than support services.
Use fleet and business teams to deepen higher-value supply and demand without fragmenting the core marketplace.
orgDesign.staffingPrinciple: Model total staffing around 250 FTE across delivery teams and group leadership; keep every delivery team at 6-10 FTE, with no individual team above 10 people.
orgDesign.groupingPrinciple: Use top-level groups for rider, supply, trust, business, and shared marketplace foundations.
orgDesign.groupLeadershipPrinciple: Every group has explicit lightweight leadership: a Head of group, product and engineering directors, and principal/staff-plus IC coverage for architecture, product quality, and cross-team standards.
